config_text:
[inputs]
r1 = "/opt/hapax/data/reads/SRR34217566_1.fastq.gz"
r2 = "/opt/hapax/data/reads/SRR34217566_2.fastq.gz"
accession = "SRR34217566"

[inputs.sample_facts]
matrix = "municipal wastewater"
place = "Szeged"
country = "Hungary"
collected = "2024"
molecule = "RNA"
basis = "PRJNA1282049 run metadata via ENA filereport. The archive gives the year only, with no month or day, so the page says 2024 and does not invent a date. The matrix is recorded as municipal wastewater because the paired DNA libraries of the same study name the plant ('Szeged Municipal Wastewater Treatment Plant') while the RNA libraries name only the city; whether this run is influent or effluent is NOT stated by the archive and is therefore not stated here, which matters because the ribosomal fraction differs by two orders of magnitude between the two."

[library]
trim_r2 = 0
trim_r2_basis = "0 because this library carries no non-template prefix: nontemplate_prefix_map.py read a mate-2 5' soft-clip mode of 0 in 5 of 5 seeds on 17,930 to 18,192 anchored reads per seed, nine times trim_from_prefix.py's floor, with mate 1's mode also 0; the histogram is flat, the mode holding 21.4 to 21.9% against a 25% floor, so trim_from_prefix.py refuses to name a prefix, and 0 is the only value that cannot delete real template (measured on instance i-00d39f385a5a96422, commit 5cb21c317fd9) (stated on the launcher; the instance's own measurement exited 2 with answer 'none' and was not used)"

[run]
seeds = 5
pairs = 200000
report_pairs = 2000
threads = 8
stages = ["profile", "cascade", "contigs", "reads", "linkage", "census", "intervals", "layers", "strains", "taxa", "divergent", "shortlist", "crossplant", "ranking"]
report_without = ["cross_sample", "rfam", "crispr", "pfam"]

[databases]
rrna = "/opt/hapax/db/silva/silva_dna.fa"
classifier = ["/opt/hapax/db/k2/k2_viral_20261022.d", "/opt/hapax/db/k2/k2_standard_08_GB_20261022.d", "/opt/hapax/db/k2/k2_pluspf_08_GB_20261022.d", "/opt/hapax/db/k2/k2_pluspf_16_GB_20261022.d"]
classifier_contigs = "/opt/hapax/db/k2/k2_pluspf_16_GB_20261022.d"
protein = "/opt/hapax/db/prot/viral.dmnd"
protein_fasta = "/opt/hapax/db/prot/viral.1.protein.faa.gz"
sprot = "/opt/hapax/db/prot/sprot.dmnd"
pfam = "/opt/hapax/db/pfam/Pfam-A.hmm"

prepared.trim_r2_source: stated in run.toml: 0 because this library carries no non-template prefix: nontemplate_prefix_map.py read a mate-2 5' soft-clip mode of 0 in 5 of 5 seeds on 17,930 to 18,192 anchored reads per seed, nine times trim_from_prefix.py's floor, with mate 1's mode also 0; the histogram is flat, the mode holding 21.4 to 21.9% against a 25% floor, so trim_from_prefix.py refuses to name a prefix, and 0 is the only value that cannot delete real template (measured on instance i-00d39f385a5a96422, commit 5cb21c317fd9) (stated on the launcher; the instance's own measurement exited 2 with answer 'none' and was not used)

measured_off_the_reads.read_length_basis: modal sequence length over the first 100000 records of each mate. Read length is the one recognition wall this project has measured moving (SPEC 4.2), so it is recorded rather than assumed comparable to another library's.
measured_off_the_reads.block_basis: derived from the 11589124 pairs counted in this file: the largest round stride that fits 5 disjoint contiguous blocks of 200000 pairs with a 10% margin, so a file that counts shorter than its metadata still reads five blocks rather than leaving the last seeds empty.

not_measurable_from_the_file.trim_r2: needs the reads mapped onto known sequence; see experiments/nontemplate_prefix_map.py and trim_from_prefix.py
not_measurable_from_the_file.sample: the matrix, place, collection date and molecule are properties of the water and of the deposit, not of the FASTQ
not_measurable_from_the_file.crossplant_panel: membership of a committed panel, not a property of the reads

prepared.note: produced by hapax run, not supplied by a caller. The split is by identification and never by assembly: a contig that assembled and could not be identified stays in the residue.

sample_facts.basis: PRJNA1282049 run metadata via ENA filereport. The archive gives the year only, with no month or day, so the page says 2024 and does not invent a date. The matrix is recorded as municipal wastewater because the paired DNA libraries of the same study name the plant ('Szeged Municipal Wastewater Treatment Plant') while the RNA libraries name only the city; whether this run is influent or effluent is NOT stated by the archive and is therefore not stated here, which matters because the ribosomal fraction differs by two orders of magnitude between the two.

note: the package translates one config into the legacy driver's flags; PLAN.md step 7 replaces the subprocess with imports
